Hi Sam —

Hope you’re doing well. We’ve been really happy with how the last month of testing went with your team — the throughput improvements you flagged at the kickoff translated to measurable cost savings for Cloudhaven in our dashboards, and your SREs had great feedback about the runtime stability.

Quick ask: would Cloudhaven be open to a short (15–20 minute) call or a brief written quote so we can build a very short customer note / case blurb highlighting the outcome? Marketing is planning a one-page customer note and a short quote we can share on our site and in sales collateral.

Separately, if someone on your team is willing to leave a quick review on TrustRadius or Capterra (2–3 sentences), we’ll send a $125 e-gift card as a thank-you. No logos or legal hoops required for the review itself — separate permission for logo use would be requested before publishing the one-page piece.

If you’re open to this, can you:
- Share one or two windows when a short call works, or reply with a short quote inline
- Let us know the best person for a quote (technical + exec perspectives are both helpful)

I’ve attached a one-pager that explains the format and sample questions. Happy to keep this very light.

Thanks again,
Ben

ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

We’re open to helping, but two items on our side: procurement needs a PO/expense note for the e-gift card, and our legal team needs to approve logo usage before anything with our name goes on your public site.

I can do a 20-min sync next Tuesday (Aug 25) at 10am ET, or we can do a quick written quote — cc’ing our procurement alias for the card details. Also can you send over the short questionnaire you mentioned?

Appreciate keeping this lightweight — happy to help the story.
